dict.string: ClassGod needs to control Safari, Chrome, and Edge to detect and switch browser tabs.
ClassGod needs Accessibility permission to detect the frontmost browser and switch to specific tabs.
ClassGod may access calendars for class schedule integrations when you choose to enable them.
ClassGod may discover devices on your local network for network-aware features.
ClassGod uses Photos access to select wallpapers and other image content.
ClassGod may access reminders for task integrations when you choose to enable them.
ClassGod may use speech recognition for voice-to-text features.
